# fortiappseccloud_waf_acceleration

Configures web content acceleration for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/acceleration`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_acceleration` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_acceleration`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_acceleration" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status             = true
    css_minify         = true
    html_minify        = true
    html_css2head      = true
    html_combine_heads = false
    js_minify          = true

    # Omit this ownership wrapper to preserve the complete remote exception_list.
    # Keep the wrapper but remove every item block to explicitly send [].
    exception_list {
      item {
        host_status = true
        host        = "static.example.com"
        url_pattern = "^/assets/"
        url_type    = "regex"
      }

      item {
        host_status = false
        url_pattern = "/health-check"
        url_type    = "string"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `css_minify` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Css minify for web content acceleration. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `html_combine_heads` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Html combine heads for web content acceleration. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `html_css2head` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Html css2head for web content acceleration. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `html_minify` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Html minify for web content acceleration. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `js_minify` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Js minify for web content acceleration. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables web content acceleration. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `exception_list` (Optional Block, at most 256 items) — Owns the ordered `exception_list.item` blocks.
      - `exception_list.item.host` (Optional, Computed, maximum 255 UTF-8 characters) — Host.
      - `exception_list.item.host_status` (Required) — Host status.
      - `exception_list.item.url_pattern` (Required, maximum 255 UTF-8 characters) — Url pattern.
      - `exception_list.item.url_type` (Required, one of `regex`, `string`) — Selects literal string or regular-expression matching; regular-expression syntax is validated by the API.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_acceleration.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
